headline: GAAP profit tumbles on deal costs as revenue holds steady
summary_short: Skyworks' revenue was roughly flat q/q at $934.8M (-3.1% y/y), while GAAP diluted EPS fell 68.6% y/y to $0.22 on higher acquisition-related and restructuring costs tied to the pending Qorvo combination; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.08.
summary_long: Revenue was roughly flat q/q, down 3.1% y/y, at $934.8M; Mobile stayed steady while Broad Markets grew y/y on automotive and data-center strength. GAAP operating margin fell to 5.2% from 11.5% y/y, mostly on $25.7M of Qorvo-related acquisition expenses and $22.0M of restructuring charges; non-GAAP operating margin held at 19.4%. GAAP diluted EPS fell 68.6% y/y to $0.22; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.08 (-18.8% y/y). Cash fell to $790.0M from $1,413.3M q/q after a $500M debt repayment and $106.9M of dividends. The board approved a new $2B buyback and ended the quarterly dividend. Q4 guidance: revenue $1,010-$1,060M; non-GAAP EPS about $1.27 at the midpoint.

drivers.explanation: CEO said revenue and earnings came in above expectations on consistent execution, with Mobile performing well on healthy demand and Broad Markets growing y/y on double-digit automotive and data-center gains.
GAAP operating margin fell to 5.2% from 11.5% y/y mainly on $25.7M of Qorvo-acquisition-related expenses (vs $2.8M y/y) and $22.0M of restructuring charges, per the non-GAAP reconciliation table.
Cash fell q/q mainly from a $500M debt repayment and $106.9M of dividends paid, per the cash flow statement; capex also rose to $87.1M from $61.4M y/y.
Long-term debt is essentially unchanged y/y; the quarter's $500M repayment (per the cash flow statement) reduced current/short-term debt, not the long-term balance.
